text: Based on the evidence, the property has not experienced any significant tree-cover loss since 2021. While there were small patches of loss (0.4 ha) in 2021, these were below the detection threshold of 0.5 ha. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 ha or more were detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025. Therefore, the property has not lost tree cover since 2021.
